_: Mixamo clips baked for the Mixamo-rigged character (web/room/char_mixamo.glb) and our chair: one row each, kimodo/mx_build.sh <Clip> <work dir> builds it into web/room/mh_mx/<out>.glb (kimodo/mx_fit.py says what each number does). The clips play on the character's own skeleton: nothing is retargeted. seatHipY is the hip joints' height over the floor (G12's, measured on our chair for v5's Hip joint, which is at the hip joints). soleUp is over his skin with the slides on (G12's 2.7 cm was for the slides missing from the skin it measured). handUp after the hands ride up with him: the performer's armrests and desk were lower than ours. keys [forward, up]: his hands while out at the keyboard (eased in by reach). clearMax: the sleeves at most this far inside the hoodie (qa.html's test).
